lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn qǐlái bù hǎo, zěnme le?
lines.english: You look not good, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shēntǐ bù hǎo, xiǎng shuìjiào.
lines.english: My body is not good, want to sleep.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Hái méi chī, bù xiǎng chī yào.
lines.english: Not yet, don't want to take medicine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Kuài chī yào, duō hē shuǐ.
lines.english: Take medicine quickly, drink more water.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ xiànzài qù chī.
lines.english: Okay, I'll go take it now.
